assumptions: No source files were edited by the independent reviewer; only this ignored review artifact was authored. Requested test/build commands produced their ordinary ignored outputs.

findings.finding: An older delayed version response could commit a full-document destination after a newer user navigation, and an older dirty notification could overwrite the pending target.
findings.evidence: Initial independent deferred-fetch repro committed 02 then 01. Final npm test confirms only latest commit/notify is accepted.

findings.finding: The #app skip link entered the hash router and rendered the 404 screen.
findings.evidence: Final document click handler intercepts the skip link, focuses/scrolls main, and preserves the route. Actual browser keyboard activation remains root acceptance.

findings.finding: Blocking dirty Back used replaceState on the prior entry, destroying its original route; resuming used a new push and lost Forward semantics.
findings.evidence: Final indexed history.go restoration/resumption passed five independent model assertions. Actual browser history remains root acceptance.

findings.finding: HTML-only changes were excluded from the automatic build identity.
